title: AuthorityRecordV1
$comment: Cross-record v1 rule: every administrative actor field and Delegation issuer must equal the enabled ADR-0009 bootstrap Human independently derived by the Human-owned broker; Agents and Delegations cannot administer authority. AuthorizationDecisionV2 is kernel-produced. Principal disablement is terminal. The verified envelope signer must be the causally active Workspace authority root.
